title: March Across the Belts
summary: The English Wikipedia article "March Across the Belts", at revision 1370627688, opens: "The March Across the Belts was a military campaign waged by the Swedish Empire across the ice between the Danish islands. It lasted between 30 January and 15 February 1658, ending with a decisive victory for Swedish King Charles X Gustav during his first Danish war." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q647694, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Swedish military campaign 1658". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
